name: @checkup/parser
description: Fault-tolerant parser for CheckUp .cup Format v2

scripts.build:renderer: npm run build && npm run build --prefix packages/renderer
scripts.build:web: npm run build && npm run build --prefix packages/renderer && npm run build --prefix apps/web
scripts.dev:web: npm run build && npm run build --prefix packages/renderer && npm run dev --prefix apps/web
scripts.typecheck:renderer: npm run build && npm run typecheck --prefix packages/renderer
